page_title: BET 2-1 RMA | Betis v Real Madrid 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Real Madrid decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
90+3' A clumsy foul by Johnny Cardoso (Betis) and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle. Real Madrid have a free kick.
90+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' The substitution has been made. Natan (Betis) has replaced Sergi Altimira.
90' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sergi Altimira (Betis) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
88' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
86' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
85' A substitution has been made. Ferland Mendy is replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
84' The shot by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Adrian.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Chimy Avila (Betis) was quite harsh and Alejandro Hernandez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Isco (Betis) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Cucho Hernandez and he is replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) for Youssouf Sabaly.

80' Ambitious effort from Endrick (Real Madrid). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
77' Real Madrid couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Adrian (Betis) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
77' It looks like Chimy Avila (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Alejandro Hernandez won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Real Madrid.
76' The attendance for today's match is 55873.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kylian Mbappe trots off the pitch and is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
74' Isco (Betis) works the corner short.
73' Isco (Betis) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. Betis earn a corner.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a change. Chimy Avila (Betis) replaces Jesus Rodriguez.
69' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Adrian, who smothers the ball.

67' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
65' PENALTY APPEAL after Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
63' The total number of attempts is 16:5.
59' Here is a change. David Alaba is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
59' Substitution. Brahim Diaz makes way for Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
59' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Marc Bartra (Betis) goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
59' Antony (Betis) will deliver the corner kick.
58' Antony (Betis) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.

58' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall. The linesman makes the right call and Betis will have a corner.
57' David Alaba (Real Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Hernandez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
56' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
54' 2 - 1 Goal! Isco (Betis) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Thibaut Courtois into left side of the goal.
54' Isco (Betis) is going to take the penalty!
53' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Hernandez had an easy-decision to make.

53' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul. That's a penalty to Betis! They have a good chance to score now.
52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
50' The corner kick from Isco (Betis) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

50' Isco (Betis) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted. The ball is out of play. Betis will have a chance to score from a corner.
49' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Betis win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
47' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' A corner kick by Betis is thwarted by the well prepared Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid).

45+2' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom left corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
45+2' Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+2' Close! Antony (Betis) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
42' 18:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.

39' Betis slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
36' Isco (Betis) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

34' 1 - 1 The ball was swung into the box by Isco from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Johnny Cardoso (Betis), who planted a long-range header into the middle of the net to make the score 1:1.
34' Isco (Betis) prepares to take a corner kick.
33' The resulting corner, taken by Isco (Betis), comes to nothing.
32' Alejandro Hernandez shows a yellow card to Luka Modric (Real Madrid) for his blatant foul.

30' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He receives a precise lofted cross inside the box and sends a quick shot to the bottom left corner, but he can't get the power to direct it past Thibaut Courtois, who gets down to save.
29' The ball possession is 35:65.

26' The ball rebounds to Marc Bartra (Betis) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he bends the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
26' Isco (Betis) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
24' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.

22' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
22' The free kick is taken by Isco (Betis), but ball is cleared.

21' Alejandro Hernandez blows for a foul after David Alaba (Real Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. It's a free kick to Betis, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
19' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Madrid, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' Dangerous play by Diego Llorente (Betis). Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid get a free kick.

13' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Rodrygo (Real Madrid). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Betis.
10' 0 - 1 Goal! Ferland Mendy feeds Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 0:1.
8' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
2' Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Betis will kick the game off.
Alejandro Hernandez is the one to supervise the game today.
